function assetPurpose(asset) {

  const path = asset.id.toLowerCase();
  const tileNumber = Number((path.match(/(?:tile|maptile)_(\d+)/) || [])[1]);
  const hasTileNumber = Number.isFinite(tileNumber);

  if (/\/interface\//.test(path)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/\/weapons?\//.test(path)) return "武器弹药";
  if (/\/enemies?\//.test(path)) return "怪物敌人";
  if (/\/players?\//.test(path) || /\/characters?\//.test(path)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
  if (/\/backgrounds?\//.test(path)) return "背景素材";
  if (/\/ships?\//.test(path)) return "载具-飞船";

  if (asset.package === "favorite-map-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_MAP_PACK_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if ([136, 137, 153, 154, 170].includes(tileNumber)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (tileNumber === 94) return "生物小动物";
    return "地图图块";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-platformer") return "平台地图素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-shmup") return "飞行射击素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-dungeon" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(FAVORITE_TINY_DUNGEON_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
    return "地牢素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-battle") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_WATER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "水域-水面";
    return "战斗地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-rpg-urban-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && tileNumber >= 23 && tileNumber <= 485 && (tileNumber - 23) % 27 <= 3) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_RPG_URBAN_TREE_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "城市RPG地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-desert-shooter-pack" && path.includes("/png/tiles/")) {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_DESERT_CHEST_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "宝箱";
    return "沙漠射击素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-ski") return "雪地滑雪素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-creatures") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_CREATURE_MONSTER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "怪物敌人";
    return "生物小动物";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-vegetation") {
    if (/tree|forest|pine/.test(text)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "植物-花草灌木";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-spawn-points") return "其他";

  if (asset.package === "tiny-town" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(TINY_TOWN_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
  }

  if (/heart|coin|potion|icon|flag/.test(text)) return "UI-图标数值";
  if (/ui|interface|panel|frame|banner/.test(text)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/particle|effect|spark|fire|torch|light|portal|vfx/.test(text)) return "特效与粒子";
  if (/ship|spaceship/.test(text)) return "载具-飞船";

  }
  packageSelect.value = activePackage;
}

function assetPurpose(asset) {
  const text = `${asset.package} ${asset.category} ${asset.id} ${asset.name}`.toLowerCase();
  const path = asset.id.toLowerCase();
  const tileNumber = Number((path.match(/(?:tile|maptile)_(\d+)/) || [])[1]);
  const hasTileNumber = Number.isFinite(tileNumber);

  if (/\/interface\//.test(path)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/\/weapons?\//.test(path)) return "武器弹药";
  if (/\/enemies?\//.test(path)) return "怪物敌人";
  if (/\/players?\//.test(path) || /\/characters?\//.test(path)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
  if (/\/backgrounds?\//.test(path)) return "背景素材";
  if (/\/ships?\//.test(path)) return "载具-飞船";

  if (asset.package === "favorite-map-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_MAP_PACK_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if ([136, 137, 153, 154, 170].includes(tileNumber)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (tileNumber === 94) return "生物小动物";
    return "地图图块";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-platformer") return "平台地图素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-shmup") return "飞行射击素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-dungeon" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(FAVORITE_TINY_DUNGEON_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
    return "地牢素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-battle") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_WATER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "水域-水面";
    return "战斗地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-rpg-urban-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && tileNumber >= 23 && tileNumber <= 485 && (tileNumber - 23) % 27 <= 3) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_RPG_URBAN_TREE_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "城市RPG地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-desert-shooter-pack" && path.includes("/png/tiles/")) {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_DESERT_CHEST_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "宝箱";
    return "沙漠射击素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-ski") return "雪地滑雪素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-creatures") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_CREATURE_MONSTER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "怪物敌人";
    return "生物小动物";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-vegetation") {
    if (/tree|forest|pine/.test(text)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "植物-花草灌木";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-spawn-points") return "其他";

  if (asset.package === "tiny-town" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(TINY_TOWN_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
  }

  if (/heart|coin|potion|icon|flag/.test(text)) return "UI-图标数值";
  if (/ui|interface|panel|frame|banner/.test(text)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/particle|effect|spark|fire|torch|light|portal|vfx/.test(text)) return "特效与粒子";
  if (/ship|spaceship/.test(text)) return "载具-飞船";

func _create_atlas_source(path: String, cols: int, rows: int, region_size: Vector2i = Vector2i(TILE, TILE), separation: Vector2i = Vector2i(1, 1)) -> TileSetAtlasSource:
	var source := TileSetAtlasSource.new()
	source.texture = _texture(path)
	source.texture_region_size = region_size
	source.separation = separation
	for y in rows:
		for x in cols:
			source.create_tile(Vector2i(x, y))
	return source

func _add_collision_to_tile(set: TileSet, source_id: int, coord: Vector2i) -> void:
	var source := set.get_source(source_id) as TileSetAtlasSource
	var tile_data := source.get_tile_data(coord, 0)
	if tile_data == null:
		return
	tile_data.add_collision_polygon(0)

	set.tile_size = Vector2i(TILE, TILE)

	for coord in [U_BOUNDARY, U_WATER, U_TREE, U_PARK_TREE, U_TRAFFIC_LIGHT, U_CRATE, U_BENCH, U_DOOR]:

	for y in range(6, 9):

	for y in range(14, 18):

	for y in range(0, 3):

	for y in range(4, 8):

			_add_collision_to_tile(set, SOURCE_TOWN, Vector2i(x, y))
	for y in range(8, 11):

	for coord in [T_TREE, T_TREE_ROUND, T_TREE_ORANGE, T_MUSHROOM, T_FENCE_H, T_FENCE_V, T_CHEST, T_WELL]:
		_add_collision_to_tile(set, SOURCE_TOWN, coord)
	return set

func _create_atlas_source(path: String, cols: int, rows: int, region_size: Vector2i = Vector2i(TILE, TILE), separation: Vector2i = Vector2i(1, 1)) -> TileSetAtlasSource:
	var source := TileSetAtlasSource.new()
	source.texture = _texture(path)
	source.texture_region_size = region_size
	source.separation = separation
	for y in rows:
		for x in cols:
			source.create_tile(Vector2i(x, y))
	return source

func _add_collision_to_tile(set: TileSet, source_id: int, coord: Vector2i) -> void:
	var source := set.get_source(source_id) as TileSetAtlasSource
	var tile_data := source.get_tile_data(coord, 0)
	if tile_data == null:
		return
	tile_data.add_collision_polygon(0)

function assetPurpose(asset) {
  const text = `${asset.package} ${asset.category} ${asset.id} ${asset.name}`.toLowerCase();
  const path = asset.id.toLowerCase();
  const tileNumber = Number((path.match(/(?:tile|maptile)_(\d+)/) || [])[1]);
  const hasTileNumber = Number.isFinite(tileNumber);

  if (/\/interface\//.test(path)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/\/weapons?\//.test(path)) return "武器弹药";
  if (/\/enemies?\//.test(path)) return "怪物敌人";
  if (/\/players?\//.test(path) || /\/characters?\//.test(path)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
  if (/\/backgrounds?\//.test(path)) return "背景素材";
  if (/\/ships?\//.test(path)) return "载具-飞船";

  if (asset.package === "favorite-map-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_MAP_PACK_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if ([136, 137, 153, 154, 170].includes(tileNumber)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (tileNumber === 94) return "生物小动物";
    return "地图图块";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-platformer") return "平台地图素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-shmup") return "飞行射击素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-dungeon" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(FAVORITE_TINY_DUNGEON_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
    return "地牢素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-battle") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_WATER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "水域-水面";
    return "战斗地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-rpg-urban-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && tileNumber >= 23 && tileNumber <= 485 && (tileNumber - 23) % 27 <= 3) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_RPG_URBAN_TREE_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "城市RPG地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-desert-shooter-pack" && path.includes("/png/tiles/")) {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_DESERT_CHEST_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "宝箱";
    return "沙漠射击素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-ski") return "雪地滑雪素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-creatures") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_CREATURE_MONSTER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "怪物敌人";
    return "生物小动物";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-vegetation") {
    if (/tree|forest|pine/.test(text)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "植物-花草灌木";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-spawn-points") return "出生点";

  if (asset.package === "tiny-town" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(TINY_TOWN_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
  }

  if (/heart|coin|potion|icon|flag/.test(text)) return "UI-图标数值";
  if (/ui|interface|panel|frame|banner/.test(text)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/particle|effect|spark|fire|torch|light|portal|vfx/.test(text)) return "特效与粒子";

function assetPurpose(asset) {
  const text = `${asset.package} ${asset.category} ${asset.id} ${asset.name}`.toLowerCase();
  const path = asset.id.toLowerCase();
  const tileNumber = Number((path.match(/(?:tile|maptile)_(\d+)/) || [])[1]);
  const hasTileNumber = Number.isFinite(tileNumber);

  if (/\/interface\//.test(path)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/\/weapons?\//.test(path)) return "武器弹药";
  if (/\/enemies?\//.test(path)) return "怪物敌人";
  if (/\/players?\//.test(path) || /\/characters?\//.test(path)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
  if (/\/backgrounds?\//.test(path)) return "背景素材";
  if (/\/ships?\//.test(path)) return "载具-飞船";

  if (asset.package === "favorite-map-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_MAP_PACK_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if ([136, 137, 153, 154, 170].includes(tileNumber)) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (tileNumber === 94) return "生物小动物";
    return "地图图块";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-platformer") return "平台地图素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-pixel-shmup") return "飞行射击素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-dungeon" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(FAVORITE_TINY_DUNGEON_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
    return "地牢素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-battle") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_NUMBER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "UI-图标数值";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_BATTLE_WATER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "水域-水面";
    return "战斗地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-rpg-urban-pack") {
    if (hasTileNumber && tileNumber >= 23 && tileNumber <= 485 && (tileNumber - 23) % 27 <= 3) return "人物-玩家NPC";
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_RPG_URBAN_TREE_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "城市RPG地图素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-desert-shooter-pack" && path.includes("/png/tiles/")) {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_DESERT_CHEST_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "宝箱";
    return "沙漠射击素材";
  }
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-ski") return "雪地滑雪素材";
  if (asset.package === "favorite-tiny-creatures") {
    if (hasTileNumber && FAVORITE_TINY_CREATURE_MONSTER_TILES.includes(tileNumber)) return "怪物敌人";
    return "生物小动物";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-vegetation") {
    if (/tree|forest|pine/.test(text)) return "植物-树木森林";
    return "植物-花草灌木";
  }
  if (asset.package === "ai-generated-tiny-spawn-points") return "出生点";

  if (asset.package === "tiny-town" && hasTileNumber) {
    for (const [purpose, numbers] of Object.entries(TINY_TOWN_PURPOSE_BY_TILE)) {
      if (numbers.includes(tileNumber)) return purpose;
    }
  }

  if (/heart|coin|potion|icon|flag/.test(text)) return "UI-图标数值";
  if (/ui|interface|panel|frame|banner/.test(text)) return "UI-界面面板";
  if (/particle|effect|spark|fire|torch|light|portal|vfx/.test(text)) return "特效与粒子";

[189] assistant: 这 72 张不是 18 个角色，而是 **6 个可移动 NPC，每个 NPC 12 帧**。

素材规律是：`favorite-rpg-urban-pack` 左侧 4 列人物区域，每个角色占 **3 行 × 4 列**。  
列表示方向，行表示该方向的 3 帧移动动画。

方向列应这样解释：

| 列 | 方向 |
|---|---|
| 第 1 列 | left 左走 |
| 第 2 列 | down 正面/向下 |
| 第 3 列 | up 背面/向上 |
| 第 4 列 | right 右走 |

每个角色的 12 帧分类如下：

| 角色 | 左走 3 帧 | 下走 3 帧 | 上走 3 帧 | 右走 3 帧 |
|---|---|---|---|---|

	var ai: Dictionary = npc.get("ai", {})
	var home: Vector2 = npc.get("home", npc.get("position", Vector2.ZERO))
	var home_cell := Vector2i(int(floor(home.x / active_cell_px)), int(floor(home.y / active_cell_px)))
	var wander_range := max(1, int(ai.get("range", 2)))
	for attempt in range(12):

			continue
		return Vector2(candidate.x * active_cell_px + active_cell_px * 0.5, candidate.y * active_cell_px + active_cell_px * 0.5)
	return home

[189] assistant: 这 72 张不是 18 个角色，而是 **6 个可移动 NPC，每个 NPC 12 帧**。

素材规律是：`favorite-rpg-urban-pack` 左侧 4 列人物区域，每个角色占 **3 行 × 4 列**。  
列表示方向，行表示该方向的 3 帧移动动画。

方向列应这样解释：

| 列 | 方向 |
|---|---|
| 第 1 列 | left 左走 |
| 第 2 列 | down 正面/向下 |
| 第 3 列 | up 背面/向上 |
| 第 4 列 | right 右走 |

每个角色的 12 帧分类如下：

| 角色 | 左走 3 帧 | 下走 3 帧 | 上走 3 帧 | 右走 3 帧 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 角色 1 | 0023, 0050, 0077 | 0024, 0051, 0078 | 0025, 0052, 0079 | 0026, 0053, 0080 |
| 角色 2 | 0104, 0131, 0158 | 0105, 0132, 0159 | 0106, 0133, 0160 | 0107, 0134, 0161 |
| 角色 3 | 0185, 0212, 0239 | 0186, 0213, 0240 | 0187, 0214, 0241 | 0188, 0215, 0242 |
| 角色 4 | 0266, 0293, 0320 | 0267, 0294, 0321 | 0268, 0295, 0322 | 0269, 0296, 0323 |
| 角色 5 | 0347, 0374, 0401 | 0348, 0375, 0402 | 0349, 0376, 0403 | 0350, 0377, 0404 |
| 角色 6 | 0428, 0455, 0482 | 0429, 0456, 0483 | 0430, 0457, 0484 | 0431, 0458, 0485 |

之前的问题是把每一行 4 张图当成一个完整角色了。正确封装应该是：

```json
"walkFrames": {
  "left": ["tile_0023", "tile_0050", "tile_0077"],
  "down": ["tile_0024", "tile_0051", "tile_0078"],
  "up": ["tile_0025", "tile_0052", "tile_0079"],
  "right": ["tile_0026", "tile_0053", "tile_0080"]
}
```

	return home

# Browser

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state. After setup, select the `iab` browser.

Keep browser work in the background by default.

Show the browser when the user's request is primarily to put a page in front of them or let them watch the interaction, such as "open localhost:3000", "go to the docs page", "take me to the PR", "show me the current tab", or "keep the browser open while you test checkout".

Do not show the browser when navigation is only a means to answer a question or verify behavior, such as "check localhost:3000 and tell me whether login works", "inspect the docs page and summarize what changed", or "verify the modal still opens correctly". ### General guidance

* Minimize interruptions as much as possible. Only ask clarifying questions if you really need to. If a user has an under-specified prompt, try to fulfill it first before asking for more information.
* Remember, the user is asking questions about what they see on the screen. Base your interactions on what is visible to the user (based on DOM and screenshots) rather than programmatically determining what they are talking about. The "first link" on the page is not necessarily the first `a href` in the DOM.
* Try not to over-complicate things. It is okay to click based on node ID if it is not clear how to determine the UI element in Playwright.
* If a tab is already on a given URL, do not call `goto` with the same URL. This will reload the page and may lose any in-progress information the user has provided. When you intentionally need to reload, call `tab.reload()`.
* If browser-use is interrupted because the extension or user took control, do not quote the raw runtime error. Summarize it naturally for the user, for example: "Browser use was stopped in the extension." Avoid internal terms like turn_id, runtime, retry, or plugin error text unless the user asks for details.
* When testing a user's local app on `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`, or another local development URL in a framework that does not support hot reloading or hot reloading is disabled, call `tab.reload()` after code or build changes before verifying the UI. After reloading, take a fresh DOM snapshot or screenshot before continuing.
* Do not brute-force undocumented site search URLs, query parameter variants, search engine query grids, or candidate URL arrays unless the user explicitly asks for exhaustive coverage.
* If a guessed URL, search query, or candidate page fails, try at most one new approach. After that, switch to visible page navigation, the site's own search UI, or give the best current answer with uncertainty.

+func _update_runtime_camera_layout() -> void:
+	if camera == null or current_map.id != MAP_EDITOR_JSON:

+	var viewport_size := get_viewport_rect().size

+	var map_size := Vector2(active_map_w * active_cell_px, active_map_h * active_cell_px)
+	if map_size.x <= 0.0 or map_size.y <= 0.0:
+		return
+	var available_size := Vector2(
+		max(1.0, viewport_size.x - RUNTIME_MAP_MARGIN * 2.0),
+		max(1.0, viewport_size.y - RUNTIME_TOP_BAR_HEIGHT - RUNTIME_BOTTOM_BAR_HEIGHT - RUNTIME_MAP_MARGIN * 2.0)
+	)
+	var fit_zoom: float = min(available_size.x / map_size.x, available_size.y / map_size.y)
+	fit_zoom = clamp(fit_zoom, 0.35, 1.0)
+	camera.zoom = Vector2(fit_zoom, fit_zoom)
+	camera.position = map_size * 0.5

[308] user: 对主角玩家进行AI定义，先出文字方案


[309] assistant: 可以把 `主角玩家` 定义成一套可复用的 AI/游戏属性模板，而不是只把它当普通图片素材。核心是：素材放进地图后，编辑器识别它属于 `主角玩家`，导出 Godot 地图时自动附带玩家属性，进入游戏后由 Godot Runtime 按这些属性生成可控制角色。

**主角玩家 AI 定义方案**

1. **素材身份定义**

每个 `favorite-quiet-dungeon-characters` 素材帧都属于 `主角玩家`，但不能每一帧都当成独立角色。需要按来源角色分组：

- `warrior_blue`：蓝色战士主角
- `warrior_red`：红色战士主角
- `character_base`：基础角色主角
- `top_down_character_v4`：俯视主角

编辑器中可以显示单帧，但逻辑上要识别同组角色，最终生成的是“一个主角角色”，不是单张图片。

2. **主角基础属性**

建议默认属性：

```json
{
  "actorType": "player",
  "role": "main_character",
  "hp": 100,
  "maxHp": 100,
  "mp": 30,
  "maxMp": 30,
  "attack": 12,
  "defense": 5,
  "speed": 120,
  "attackRange": 32,
  "collision": true,
  "canMove": true,
  "canInteract": true,
  "canAttack": true
}
```

3. **动画定义**

对 `warrior_blue / warrior_red / character_base` 这种 `768x256` 切出来的帧，需要建立动作映射，而不是随机播放。

建议先按原始 sheet 结构建立：

```json
{
  "spriteFrameSize": [32, 32],
  "sheetCols": 24,
  "sheetRows": 8,
  "animations": {
    "idle_down": [],
    "idle_left": [],
    "idle_right": [],
    "idle_up": [],
    "walk_down": [],
    "walk_left": [],
    "walk_right": [],
    "walk_up": [],
    "attack_down": [],
    "attack_left": [],
    "attack_right": [],
    "attack_up": [],
    "hurt": [],
    "dead": []
  }
}
```

这里最关键的是：需要根据原素材实际动作行列确认每一行动作含义。确认后写成固定规则，之后编辑器只需要知道角色组名，就能自动调用整套动画。

4. **AI 行为定义**

主角本身主要是玩家控制，但也可以有 AI 辅助属性：

```json
{
  "ai": {
    "controlMode": "player",
    "autoFaceTarget": true,
    "autoInteractWhenNear": true,
    "autoAttackNearestEnemy": false,
    "pathfinding": true,
    "avoidObstacles": true
  }
}
```

解释：

- `controlMode: player`：主角由键盘控制。
- `autoFaceTarget`：靠近 NPC 或敌人时自动朝向目标。
- `autoInteractWhenNear`：按互动键时自动找最近 NPC/宝箱。
- `autoAttackNearestEnemy`：默认关闭，避免玩家失控；以后可以做自动战斗模式。
- `pathfinding`：如果之后支持点击地图移动，可以启用。
- `avoidObstacles`：遵守地图碰撞边界。

5. **编辑器放置规则**

主角玩家不应该像树木、石头一样无限放置。建议规则：

- 地图中最多允许一个 `主角玩家`。
- 放置新的主角时，自动替换旧主角。
- 主角素材不作为普通地图装饰导出，而是导出到 `playerSpawn` 或 `playerActor` 字段。
- 如果地图已有 `出生点`，主角优先出生在出生点；否则出生在用户放置主角的位置。

导出结构建议：

```json
{
  "player": {
    "id": "player_1",
    "character": "warrior_blue",
    "spawn": { "x": 10, "y": 8 },
    "stats": {
      "hp": 100,
      "attack": 12,
      "speed": 120
    },
    "animations": "warrior_blue"
  }
}
```

6. **Godot Runtime 规则**

进入游戏后：

- 读取 `player.character`
- 加载对应角色帧
- 创建 `CharacterBody2D`
- 添加碰撞体
- 绑定移动输入
- 根据方向切换 walk/idle
- 按攻击键播放 attack
- 与 NPC/敌人/宝箱互动

Godot 中主角节点建议：

```text
PlayerCharacter
- CharacterBody2D
  - AnimatedSprite2D
  - CollisionShape2D
  - InteractionArea
  - AttackArea
```

7. **后续实现优先级**

建议按这个顺序做：

1. 先建立 `主角玩家` 元数据：角色组、属性、是否可控制。
2. 编辑器中限制主角只允许放一个。
3. 导出 JSON 增加 `player` 字段。
4. Godot 读取 `player` 并生成主角。
5. 再补动作映射：idle / walk / attack。
6. 最后做 AI 辅助：自动朝向、互动、寻路、自动攻击。

当前最适合先定义的主角是：

`warrior_blue`

因为它已经是当前项目主角同风格素材，并且有完整 `768x256` 动作 sheet，可以作为默认玩家模板。

func _player_frame_texture(column: int, row: int) -> Texture2D:
	return _character_frame_texture(player_sheet, column, row)


func _character_frame_texture(sheet: Texture2D, column: int, row: int) -> Texture2D:
	var frame := AtlasTexture.new()
	frame.atlas = sheet
	frame.region = Rect2(
		column * PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		row * PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE
	)
	return frame


func _update_player_animation(input_vector: Vector2) -> void:
	if player_attacking or player_hurt or player_dead:
		return

	if input_vector.length_squared() > 0.0:
		if absf(input_vector.x) > absf(input_vector.y):
			player_facing = "right" if input_vector.x > 0.0 else "left"
		else:
			player_facing = "down" if input_vector.y > 0.0 else "up"
		_play_player_animation("walk_%s" % player_facing)
	else:
		_play_player_animation("idle_%s" % player_facing)


func _update_assist_player(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not assist_player or not is_instance_valid(assist_player):
		return
	var input_vector := _player_input_vector()
	assist_player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO if assist_player_attacking else input_vector.normalized() * PLAYER_SPEED
	assist_player.move_and_slide()
	_update_assist_player_animation(input_vector)


func _update_assist_player_animation(input_vector: Vector2) -> void:
	if not assist_player_anim or assist_player_attacking:
		return
	if input_vector.length_squared() > 0.0:
		if absf(input_vector.x) > absf(input_vector.y):
			assist_player_facing = "right" if input_vector.x > 0.0 else "left"
		else:
			assist_player_facing = "down" if input_vector.y > 0.0 else "up"
		_play_assist_player_animation("walk_%s" % assist_player_facing)
	else:
		_play_assist_player_animation("idle_%s" % assist_player_facing)


func _play_assist_player_animation(name: String) -> void:
	if not assist_player_anim:
		return
	if assist_player_anim.animation == name and assist_player_anim.is_playing():
		return
	assist_player_anim.play(name)

		var speed := _projectile_speed(projectile_kind) * float(arrow.get_meta("speed_multiplier", 1.0))
		if age >= lifetime:
			_remove_arrow(arrow)
			continue

		arrow.global_position += direction * speed * delta
		if _arrow_hit_wall(previous_position, arrow.global_position):

[308] user: 对主角玩家进行AI定义，先出文字方案


[309] assistant: 可以把 `主角玩家` 定义成一套可复用的 AI/游戏属性模板，而不是只把它当普通图片素材。核心是：素材放进地图后，编辑器识别它属于 `主角玩家`，导出 Godot 地图时自动附带玩家属性，进入游戏后由 Godot Runtime 按这些属性生成可控制角色。

**主角玩家 AI 定义方案**

1. **素材身份定义**

每个 `favorite-quiet-dungeon-characters` 素材帧都属于 `主角玩家`，但不能每一帧都当成独立角色。需要按来源角色分组：

- `warrior_blue`：蓝色战士主角
- `warrior_red`：红色战士主角
- `character_base`：基础角色主角
- `top_down_character_v4`：俯视主角

编辑器中可以显示单帧，但逻辑上要识别同组角色，最终生成的是“一个主角角色”，不是单张图片。

2. **主角基础属性**

建议默认属性：

```json
{
  "actorType": "player",
  "role": "main_character",
  "hp": 100,
  "maxHp": 100,
  "mp": 30,
  "maxMp": 30,
  "attack": 12,
  "defense": 5,
  "speed": 120,
  "attackRange": 32,
  "collision": true,
  "canMove": true,
  "canInteract": true,
  "canAttack": true
}
```

3. **动画定义**

对 `warrior_blue / warrior_red / character_base` 这种 `768x256` 切出来的帧，需要建立动作映射，而不是随机播放。

建议先按原始 sheet 结构建立：

```json
{
  "spriteFrameSize": [32, 32],
  "sheetCols": 24,
  "sheetRows": 8,
  "animations": {
    "idle_down": [],
    "idle_left": [],
    "idle_right": [],
    "idle_up": [],
    "walk_down": [],
    "walk_left": [],
    "walk_right": [],
    "walk_up": [],
    "attack_down": [],
    "attack_left": [],
    "attack_right": [],
    "attack_up": [],
    "hurt": [],
    "dead": []
  }
}
```

这里最关键的是：需要根据原素材实际动作行列确认每一行动作含义。确认后写成固定规则，之后编辑器只需要知道角色组名，就能自动调用整套动画。

4. **AI 行为定义**

主角本身主要是玩家控制，但也可以有 AI 辅助属性：

```json
{
  "ai": {
    "controlMode": "player",
    "autoFaceTarget": true,
    "autoInteractWhenNear": true,
    "autoAttackNearestEnemy": false,
    "pathfinding": true,
    "avoidObstacles": true
  }
}
```

解释：

- `controlMode: player`：主角由键盘控制。
- `autoFaceTarget`：靠近 NPC 或敌人时自动朝向目标。
- `autoInteractWhenNear`：按互动键时自动找最近 NPC/宝箱。
- `autoAttackNearestEnemy`：默认关闭，避免玩家失控；以后可以做自动战斗模式。
- `pathfinding`：如果之后支持点击地图移动，可以启用。
- `avoidObstacles`：遵守地图碰撞边界。

5. **编辑器放置规则**

主角玩家不应该像树木、石头一样无限放置。建议规则：

- 地图中最多允许一个 `主角玩家`。
- 放置新的主角时，自动替换旧主角。
- 主角素材不作为普通地图装饰导出，而是导出到 `playerSpawn` 或 `playerActor` 字段。
- 如果地图已有 `出生点`，主角优先出生在出生点；否则出生在用户放置主角的位置。

导出结构建议：

```json
{
  "player": {
    "id": "player_1",
    "character": "warrior_blue",
    "spawn": { "x": 10, "y": 8 },
    "stats": {
      "hp": 100,
      "attack": 12,
      "speed": 120
    },
    "animations": "warrior_blue"
  }
}
```

6. **Godot Runtime 规则**

进入游戏后：

- 读取 `player.character`
- 加载对应角色帧
- 创建 `CharacterBody2D`
- 添加碰撞体
- 绑定移动输入
- 根据方向切换 walk/idle
- 按攻击键播放 attack
- 与 NPC/敌人/宝箱互动

Godot 中主角节点建议：

```text
PlayerCharacter
- CharacterBody2D
  - AnimatedSprite2D
  - CollisionShape2D
  - InteractionArea
  - AttackArea
```

7. **后续实现优先级**

建议按这个顺序做：

1. 先建立 `主角玩家` 元数据：角色组、属性、是否可控制。
2. 编辑器中限制主角只允许放一个。
3. 导出 JSON 增加 `player` 字段。
4. Godot 读取 `player` 并生成主角。
5. 再补动作映射：idle / walk / attack。
6. 最后做 AI 辅助：自动朝向、互动、寻路、自动攻击。

当前最适合先定义的主角是：

`warrior_blue`

因为它已经是当前项目主角同风格素材，并且有完整 `768x256` 动作 sheet，可以作为默认玩家模板。

func _player_frame_texture(column: int, row: int) -> Texture2D:
	return _character_frame_texture(player_sheet, column, row)


func _character_frame_texture(sheet: Texture2D, column: int, row: int) -> Texture2D:
	var frame := AtlasTexture.new()
	frame.atlas = sheet
	frame.region = Rect2(
		column * PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		row * PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE,
		PLAYER_FRAME_SIZE
	)
	return frame


func _update_player_animation(input_vector: Vector2) -> void:
	if player_attacking or player_hurt or player_dead:
		return

	if input_vector.length_squared() > 0.0:
		if absf(input_vector.x) > absf(input_vector.y):
			player_facing = "right" if input_vector.x > 0.0 else "left"
		else:
			player_facing = "down" if input_vector.y > 0.0 else "up"
		_play_player_animation("walk_%s" % player_facing)
	else:
		_play_player_animation("idle_%s" % player_facing)


func _update_assist_player(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not assist_player or not is_instance_valid(assist_player):
		return
	var input_vector := _player_input_vector()
	assist_player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO if assist_player_attacking else input_vector.normalized() * PLAYER_SPEED
	assist_player.move_and_slide()
	_update_assist_player_animation(input_vector)


func _update_assist_player_animation(input_vector: Vector2) -> void:
	if not assist_player_anim or assist_player_attacking:
		return
	if input_vector.length_squared() > 0.0:
		if absf(input_vector.x) > absf(input_vector.y):
			assist_player_facing = "right" if input_vector.x > 0.0 else "left"
		else:
			assist_player_facing = "down" if input_vector.y > 0.0 else "up"
		_play_assist_player_animation("walk_%s" % assist_player_facing)
	else:
		_play_assist_player_animation("idle_%s" % assist_player_facing)


func _play_assist_player_animation(name: String) -> void:
	if not assist_player_anim:
		return
	if assist_player_anim.animation == name and assist_player_anim.is_playing():
		return
	assist_player_anim.play(name)

func _update_arrows(delta: float) -> void:
	for arrow in arrows.duplicate():
		if not is_instance_valid(arrow):
			arrows.erase(arrow)
			continue

		var previous_position: Vector2 = arrow.global_position
		var direction := arrow.get_meta("direction") as Vector2
		var age := float(arrow.get_meta("age", 0.0)) + delta
		var projectile_kind := String(arrow.get_meta("projectile_kind", "player_arrow"))
		arrow.set_meta("age", age)
		if projectile_kind == "enemy_bubble" and bool(arrow.get_meta("can_split", false)) and not bool(arrow.get_meta("split_done", false)) and age >= float(arrow.get_meta("split_time", OCEAN_SPLIT_BUBBLE_TIME)):
			arrow.set_meta("split_done", true)
			_split_ocean_bubble(arrow)
			_show_arrow_impact(arrow.global_position, _projectile_impact_color(projectile_kind))
			_remove_arrow(arrow)
			continue
		var lifetime := _projectile_lifetime(projectile_kind)
		var speed := _projectile_speed(projectile_kind) * float(arrow.get_meta("speed_multiplier", 1.0))
		if age >= lifetime:
			_remove_arrow(arrow)
			continue

		arrow.global_position += direction * speed * delta
		if _arrow_hit_wall(previous_position, arrow.global_position):
			_show_arrow_impact(arrow.global_position, _projectile_impact_color(projectile_kind))
			_remove_arrow(arrow)
			continue

		if _is_enemy_projectile_kind(projectile_kind):
			if _enemy_projectile_hit_player(arrow.global_position, projectile_kind):
				_damage_player(int(arrow.get_meta("damage", 1)), arrow.get_meta("source_enemy", null))
